content.transcript: Coastal wetlands can reduce flood damage by slowing waves and storing water during storms. They also provide habitat for fish and birds. However, roads and buildings can prevent wetlands from moving inland as sea levels rise. The speaker argues that protecting existing wetlands and leaving room for them to migrate are both important parts of coastal planning.
